items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Harold Arlen was a piano player with a band from Buffalo. And he had that... I don't know how to say it. He had that talent that Black musicians have. He had that Blues thing. Because that's how... It was amazing... I got an idea of repetition through hearing that.

ctx.x: Well, this is where you and I come in together, is when we're coming downtown to 48th and Broadway.
Right. So we went downtown, and they got... Harold Arlen was the guy that wrote the shows uptown, because the first big show he...
